name: videoclaw-port
description: Windows port scaffold of Videoclaw 0.0.40 (faithful IPC/process model, fake backend)

scripts.build: npm run gen && npm run typecheck && npm run bundle
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && node tools/package.mjs --platform linux
scripts.package:linux:dir: npm run build && node tools/package.mjs --platform linux --targets dir
scripts.package:win: npm run build && node tools/package.mjs --platform win --arch x64
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && node tools/package.mjs --platform mac --arch arm64
